title: REQ · Pure runtime systems over serializable game state
summary: State, conditions, flags, inventory, events, dialogue/choices and scene transitions as pure functions
description: Context: no game runtime exists. Desired behavior: a GameState (currentScene, inventory, discoveredObjects, completedQuests, relationships, flags, history, activeDialogue) and pure systems that evaluate conditions, apply events, run object actions, advance dialogue and switch scenes. Expected result: every function takes state and returns a new state. Why: deterministic, testable, persistable gameplay.
acceptance_criteria: Given a state and an action with events set_flag, add_item, goto_scene, when performAction runs, then the returned state has the flag, item and new currentScene and the original state is unchanged.
Given a condition {flag,equals} or {has_item}, when evaluated, then it returns true or false matching the state.
Given a dialogue node with choices, when a choice is selected, then its events are applied, history records it and the next node becomes active.
Given an action whose conditions fail, when performed, then the state is returned unchanged.
technical_constraints: Action ids limited to inspect, push, search, leave
